description: 2 tactical challenges for White in the Wing Gambit. Play 2.b4! and open the queenside against the Sicilian.

drills.briefExplanation: 2.b4! cxb4 3.a3! d5 4.exd5 Qxd5 — sacrifice the wing pawn for open lines.
drills.description: White to play. Black plays the Sicilian 1...c5 — answer with the Wing Gambit 2.b4!.
drills.explanation: The Wing Gambit: White sacrifices the b-pawn to open the a- and b-files against the Sicilian. After 2.b4! cxb4 3.a3! d5 4.exd5 Qxd5 White has the classic gambit setup — open lines, fast development, and pressure down the half-open files. Black's queenside majority is slow; White's initiative is immediate.
drills.name: The Wing Sacrifice

drills.briefExplanation: 2.b4! d6 3.bxc5 dxc5 — if Black declines, trade into an open queenside.
drills.description: White to play. Black may decline the Wing — trade and open the position.
drills.explanation: Against the solid 2...d6 decline, White keeps the gambit spirit by trading: 3.bxc5 dxc5 opens the b-file and the queenside. White's rook will swing to b1 with pressure, Black's c-pawn is fixed as a target, and the 'declined' gambit still yields the initiative. Open files are the gambiteer's wages.
drills.name: Opening the Queenside
